messages:
Jamie (CSM): Heads-up — Novalabs renewal needs signer + vendor-code path sorted by EOD Fri or we risk losing the dedicated slot. Looping Julia.
Julia (Customer): Thanks Jamie. Procurement says they need billing-entity change reflected on the PO and wire instructions. Can you confirm vendor code? cc @Ryan
Ryan (AE): I have their PO draft. Legal will need to clear the signer. @Amy, can we accept the Finance Director as signer or do we need exec-level?
Amy (Legal): We can accept Finance Director if we get a delegation-of-authority doc + ID. Need notarized delegation ideally. Template: https://redwood.internal/templates/delegation.pdf
Sam (Billing): Current vendor code for the original entity is VEND-3321. For a new "Novalabs Group" entity we need a vendor request form + tax ID to create a new code.
Julia (Customer): Sending docs now — PO# 987654, Tax ID 12-3456789. I'll email delegation letter in a minute.
Jamie (CSM): Two blockers: (1) legal approval on delegated signer, (2) billing to provision vendor code + invoice routing. If both clear, we can route to e-sign today. @ops-bot will queue invoice.
ops-bot: Invoice generation queued for thread 4412675300. ETA ~10m. Use `/invoice status 4412675300` to check.
Amy (Legal): Quick review of the delegation letter: it needs a notarized signature to meet our contract stamp. Julia — can you get a notary or provide exec sign-off instead?
Julia (Customer): Notary isn't available until Monday. I can escalate for exec signature — trying now.
Ryan (AE): If exec sig can't happen before EOD, propose fallback: accept wire payment + completed vendor request form + PO + SOW signed by Finance Director. Then finalize contract signature on Monday. Is finance OK with that?
Sam (Billing): Wire is acceptable as a temporary path. We need remittance instructions and the vendor form. I can provision a provisional vendor code once docs land.
Jamie (CSM): I'll draft a short amendment to allow provisional vendor for invoicing pending notarized delegation. @Amy, legal OK to approve that wording?
Amy (Legal): Yes — we can approve a 7-day conditional clause: "Payment via provisional vendor code accepted pending receipt of notarized delegation within 7 days." Send the draft and I'll sign off.
Jamie (CSM): Draft sent to thread. Julia, can the Finance Director sign the SOW now so we can accept the wire and keep the slot?
Julia (Customer): Confirmed — FD signed the SOW and sent wire instructions. Uploading proof to our procurement portal and cc'ing you.
ops-bot: Invoice 2026-08-15-4412675300 created and emailed to julia@novalabs.com
Sam (Billing): Provisional vendor code VEND-PROV-987 created. Invoice issued to that code. Once notarized delegation arrives, I'll migrate invoices to final code VEND-3322 and update records.
Julia (Customer): :thumbsup: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Jamie (CSM): :thumbsup: Closing the loop for now. I'll follow up Mon for the notarized doc but renewal slot remains reserved while we reconcile payment.
